scripts.dev: npm run build -w @shadow-clash/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client "npm run dev -w @shadow-clash/shared" "node --env-file-if-exists=.env --import tsx --watch apps/server/src/index.ts" "npm run dev -w @shadow-clash/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @shadow-clash/shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server && tsc --noEmit -p apps/client && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.build: npm run build -w @shadow-clash/shared && npm run build -w @shadow-clash/server && npm run build -w @shadow-clash/client
